title: Deploying into customer environments
summary: Running a system in infrastructure the customer owns: their cloud accounts, containers and CI/CD, serverless, restricted networks, and the cost and latency profile of LLM systems.
intro: This module covers how a system gets running inside infrastructure the customer owns: their cloud accounts (AWS, Google Cloud and Azure), containers, CI/CD and serverless delivery, and their private, air-gapped or classified networks. It closes with the scaling and performance-cost tradeoffs of LLM systems, which decide whether a deployment survives production.

lessons.title: Deploying into customer clouds: AWS, Google Cloud and Azure
Networking for private, air-gapped and classified customer environments
Scaling and performance-cost tradeoffs for LLM systems
